captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a standard T-slot nut used for securing fixtures in machine tool beds. It features a T-shaped profile with a wider base and a narrower neck, designed to slide into a T-slot track. A threaded hole runs completely through the center of the block perpendicular to its length, featuring a slight chamfer on one opening.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric T-nut in OpenSCAD with customizable dimensions for the total length, height, and width, as well as the height and width of the narrow neck. It must include a threaded center hole with adjustable major diameter and thread pitch, rescaled for metric 3D printing.
captions.factory: The main T-nut shape is constructed using a difference() operation. A base cube is defined with the overall height, width, and length. Two smaller cubes are subtracted from the sides of the base block to create the characteristic T-profile steps. A central threaded hole is then subtracted, consisting of a chamfered entry cylinder and a detailed screw thread generated dynamically using a custom helical thread module.
